title: Surreal Mind Projection
description: A large stylized white figure with black outlines occupies the left side, mouth open as a swirling stream of colorful elements flows from it toward a bright yellow sun in the upper right. The stream contains two blue-haired female faces, a pink brain, and a steampunk robot standing on a miniature cityscape. The background features a fragmented stained-glass sky with green raindrops falling over stylized blue and green flowers.
